name: Fuji Speedway
summary: Mount Fuji in the background and, usually, rain in the foreground.
character: A very long main straight in the shadow of Mount Fuji. Rebuilt by Toyota for F1's return in 2007, when the race ran in heavy rain and fog.

moments.title: Hunt takes the title in the rain
moments.body: In torrential rain in 1976, Niki Lauda withdrew after two laps. James Hunt finished third and won the championship by one point.

leftCalendar: The Japanese Grand Prix went back to Suzuka from 2009.
